chapters.title: 1. SELECT 选择列
chapters.content:
## 示例笔记
选择希望返回的列。示例中的 customers 是假设的练习表。

```sql
SELECT name, city
FROM customers;
```

chapters.title: 2. WHERE 筛选行
chapters.content:
## 示例笔记
WHERE 只保留满足条件的行。

```sql
SELECT name
FROM customers
WHERE city = '上海';
```

chapters.title: 3. DISTINCT 去重
chapters.content:
## 示例笔记
对所选列组合去重。

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT city
FROM customers;
```

chapters.title: 4. ORDER BY 排序
chapters.content:
## 示例笔记
先按城市升序，同城时按姓名降序。

```sql
SELECT name, city
FROM customers
ORDER BY city ASC, name DESC;
```

chapters.title: 5. AND 与 OR
chapters.content:
## 示例笔记
AND 表示同时满足，OR 表示至少满足其一。复杂条件用括号明确分组。

```sql
SELECT name
FROM customers
WHERE city = '上海' OR city = '北京';
```

chapters.title: 6. GROUP BY 聚合
chapters.content:
## 示例笔记
按城市分组，统计每组的行数。

```sql
SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customers
GROUP BY city;
```

chapters.title: 7. LEFT JOIN 关联
chapters.content:
## 示例笔记
保留左表客户；没有匹配订单时，右表列返回 NULL。

```sql
SELECT c.name, o.id
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON c.id = o.customer_id;
```
